description: This file defines the IDispatcher interface within the Thunder::PluginHost namespace. It declares an abstract interface for dispatching events, invoking methods, managing subscriptions, lifecycle management of dispatchers, and handling dropped callbacks. The interface includes nested ICallback class for event notifications and manages external dependencies via included headers.
external_methods: Core::hresult Event(const string&, const string&, const string&)
Core::hresult Invoke(uint32_t, uint32_t, const string&, const string&, const string&, string&)
Core::hresult Subscribe(ICallback*, const string&, const string&)
Core::hresult Unsubscribe(ICallback*, const string&, const string&)
